dedupe_keys.name: gm seus ground mounted solar arrays and panel rows

description: The GM-SEUS team publishes geospatial outlines of ground-mounted solar arrays and panel rows in the United States. The Zenodo release lists the main mapping package, labelled imagery and a README; the descriptor says vector files are provided as GeoPackage and Shapefile, with CSV summaries and 17,500 input and target images. Public access is free under CC BY 4.0. These locations and shapes can improve photovoltaic asset inventories for capacity or hazard-exposure simulations, alongside data-global-power-plant-database at a different level of detail. A caveat is that mapped panel area is not observed electrical capacity or delivered energy. Detection accuracy and source attribution vary with imagery, ground truth and region. The README and spatial attributes need file-level inspection before joining arrays to plants or feeders. Repository metadata and the package list were checked, but imagery and geometry files were not downloaded.
